# `Q-12-9` — Deprecated `.ejs.md` Template Extension

> A listing template uses the deprecated `.ejs.md` extension;
> rename it to `.ejs`.

## What this means

Quarto 1 supported `.ejs.md` as an extension for custom listing
templates — an EJS template whose output was post-processed as
markdown. Quarto 2 simplifies the model: templates are EJS, full
stop. The file should end in `.ejs`.

The listing still renders, but the deprecated extension will
stop being recognized in a future Quarto 2 release. The warning
fires now so the migration can happen incrementally.

## Why this happens

The listing configuration was carried over from a Quarto 1
project (or copied from a Quarto 1 example) without renaming the
template file.

## How to fix

Rename the file from `something.ejs.md` to `something.ejs`,
and update the `template:` value to match. The Q1 → Q2 listing
template migration guide describes the small set of other
changes you may need at the same time.
